title: Enclosure Air Quality During Printing
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=workshop:air location=printer_enclosure
| timechart span=5m max(voc_index) as voc, max(pm25) as pm25
| eval ventilate=if(voc>250 OR pm25>25,1,0)
description: Monitors fumes and fine particles inside your printer enclosure so you can ventilate when printing materials that off-gas.
value: Some filaments release irritating fumes and ultrafine particles; watching enclosure air quality keeps your workshop safe to breathe.
implementation: Place an air-quality sensor in the enclosure feeding `index=personal`; alert when VOC or particulate levels climb.
visualization: Time chart of enclosure VOC and particulate levels with thresholds.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the air inside your 3D printer's box for fumes and dust, so you know when to open a window.
